as_told.title: Lockheed and TRW crates in Close Encounters as crash retrieval hints

plain: Michels says that in Steven Spielberg's 1977 film about meeting aliens, Close Encounters of the Third Kind, some crates are stamped TRW and Skunk Works. TRW is a defense and aerospace contractor, and Skunk Works is the secret aircraft design shop of the company Lockheed. He has raised this in three episodes, saying few people back then knew much about these two cutting-edge research outfits. Once he puts that "in the late 80s", and in a later episode he names Lockheed and TRW as two programs that were probably recovering crashed UFOs when the film was made, which to him hints that Spielberg knew something about hidden work on such craft.
